query_en: What is the capital of India?
answers: नई दिल्ली भारत की राजधानी है।
passage: नई दिल्ली भारत की आधिकारिक राजधानी है। यह भारत सरकार के तीन अंगों: कार्यपालिका, विधायिका और न्यायपालिका का केंद्र है। राष्ट्रपति भवन, संसद भवन और सर्वोच्च न्यायालय नई दिल्ली में ही स्थित हैं।
passage_en: New Delhi is the official capital of India. It serves as the seat of all three branches of the Government of India: Executive, Legislature, and Judiciary. Rashtrapati Bhavan, Parliament House, and the Supreme Court are located here.

query_en: Where is the headquarters of ISRO located?

passage_en: Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) is the national space agency of India. Its headquarters is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka. ISRO was established in 1969 and launched Chandrayaan and Mangalyaan.

query: How does vector search function in RAG systems?
answers: Vector search converts text into dense embeddings and calculates cosine similarity to retrieve relevant passages.
passage: Vector search in RAG transforms documents and user queries into numerical vectors (dense embeddings) using bi-encoder models. By measuring vector distances like Cosine Similarity or Inner Product, the retrieval engine quickly retrieves top-k matching document passages within milliseconds.

query_en: What is the capital of Tamil Nadu?
passage: சென்னை தமிழ்நாட்டின் தலைநகரமும் மிகப்பெரிய நகரமும் ஆகும். இது வங்காள விரிகுடாவின் கொரமண்டலக் கரையில் அமைந்துள்ளது. சென்னை தென்னிந்தியாவின் கலாச்சார, பொருளாதார மற்றும் கல்வி மையங்களில் ஒன்றாகும்.
passage_en: Chennai is the capital and largest city of Tamil Nadu. Located on the Coromandel Coast of the Bay of Bengal, it is a major cultural, economic, and educational hub in South India.

query: What are model guardrails in LLM pipelines?
answers: Model guardrails are safety and verification rules that filter inappropriate inputs, prevent hallucinations, and reject ungrounded queries.
passage: Model guardrails act as a defensive wrapper around LLMs. Pre-execution guardrails scan for off-topic, toxic, or prompt-injection attempts. Post-execution guardrails inspect the generated response for factual groundedness, ensuring the LLM does not hallucinate facts outside the retrieved dataset context.
passage_en: Model guardrails act as a defensive wrapper around LLMs. Pre-execution guardrails scan for off-topic, toxic, or prompt-injection attempts. Post-execution guardrails inspect the generated response for factual groundedness, ensuring the LLM does not hallucinate facts outside the retrieved dataset context.

passage_en: Rabindranath Tagore was a world-famous Bengali poet and Nobel Laureate. In 1913, he won the Nobel Prize in Literature for Gitanjali. He composed the national anthems of both India and Bangladesh.

query: What is the sub-200ms latency requirement in real-time Voice RAG?
answers: Sub-200ms latency requires ultra-fast vector retrieval, streaming speech-to-text, and optimized inference harnesses.
passage: In voice-enabled RAG applications, maintaining an end-to-end latency below 200 milliseconds is essential for natural human conversation. query: What is the difference between fixed-size and semantic chunking?
answers: Fixed-size chunking splits text by token counts, while semantic chunking breaks text at natural sentence boundaries preserving context.
passage: Fixed-size chunking breaks text into rigid segments of fixed token lengths with fixed character overlaps. In contrast, semantic chunking inspects sentence structures, punctuation boundaries, or semantic distance changes to ensure coherent complete ideas are retained inside individual vector chunks.

In contrast, semantic chunking inspects sentence structures, punctuation boundaries, or semantic distance changes to ensure coherent complete ideas are retained inside individual vector chunks.

query: What is MS MARCO XI by AI4Bharat?

answers: મહાત્મા ગાંધીનો જન્મ ગુજરાતના પોરબંદરમાં થયો હતો.
passage: મોહનદાસ કરમચંદ ગાંધી, જેમને મહાત્મા ગાંધી તરીકે ઓળખવામાં આવે છે, તેમનો જન્મ 2 ઑક્ટોબર 1869ના રોજ ગુજરાતના પોરબંદરમાં થયો હતો. તેઓ ભારતીય સ્વતંત્રતા ચળવળના મુખ્ય નેતા હતા અને અહિંસા અને સત્યાગ્રહના સિદ્ધાંતોના પ્રણેતા હતા.
passage_en: Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, known as Mahatma Gandhi, was born on 2 October 1869 in Porbandar, Gujarat. He was the key leader of the Indian independence movement and the pioneer of the principles of non-violence and Satyagraha.

query_en: What is the capital of Maharashtra?
passage: मुंबई ही महाराष्ट्र राज्याची राजधानी आणि भारतातील सर्वात मोठे शहर आहे. हे भारताचे आर्थिक केंद्र आहे आणि बॉम्बे स्टॉक एक्सचेंज, रिझर्व बँक ऑफ इंडिया आणि अनेक बहुराष्ट्रीय कंपन्यांचे मुख्यालय येथे आहे.
passage_en: Mumbai is the capital of Maharashtra state and the largest city in India. It is the financial capital of India and houses the Bombay Stock Exchange, Reserve Bank of India, and headquarters of many multinational companies.

query: കേരളത്തെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സ്വന്തം നാട് എന്ന് വിളിക്കുന്നത് എന്തുകൊണ്ട്?
query_en: Why is Kerala called God's Own Country?
answers: കേരളത്തിന്റെ പ്രകൃതി സൗന്ദര്യവും കായലുകളും മലനിരകളും കാരണം ഇതിനെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സ്വന്തം നാട് എന്ന് വിളിക്കുന്നു.
passage: കേരളം ഇന്ത്യയുടെ തെക്കുപടിഞ്ഞാറൻ തീരത്ത് സ്ഥിതി ചെയ്യുന്ന ഒരു സംസ്ഥാനമാണ്. അതിന്റെ മനോഹരമായ കായലുകൾ, പശ്ചിമഘട്ട മലനിരകൾ, തേയിലത്തോട്ടങ്ങൾ, സുന്ദരമായ കടൽത്തീരങ്ങൾ എന്നിവ കാരണം ഇതിനെ 'ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സ്വന്തം നാട്' എന്ന് വിളിക്കുന്നു. ആയുർവേദം, കഥകളി തുടങ്ങിയ പൈതൃക കലകൾക്കും കേരളം പ്രശസ്തമാണ്.
passage_en: Kerala is a state situated on the southwestern coast of India. It is called 'God's Own Country' because of its beautiful backwaters, Western Ghats mountain ranges, tea plantations, and stunning beaches. Kerala is also famous for Ayurveda and heritage art forms like Kathakali.

query: ಬೆಂಗಳೂರನ್ನು ಭಾರತದ ಸಿಲಿಕಾನ್ ವ್ಯಾಲಿ ಎಂದು ಏಕೆ ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ?
query_en: Why is Bangalore called the Silicon Valley of India?
answers: ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ಅನೇಕ ಐಟಿ ಕಂಪನಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಟಾರ್ಟ್‌ಅಪ್‌ಗಳ ಕೇಂದ್ರವಾಗಿರುವ ಕಾರಣ ಇದನ್ನು ಭಾರತದ ಸಿಲಿಕಾನ್ ವ್ಯಾಲಿ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
passage: ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ರಾಜ್ಯದ ರಾಜಧಾನಿ ಮತ್ತು ಭಾರತದ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕೇಂದ್ರವಾಗಿದೆ. ಇನ್ಫೋಸಿಸ್, ವಿಪ್ರೋ ಮತ್ತು ನೂರಾರು ಬಹುರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ ಕಂಪನಿಗಳ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಕಚೇರಿಗಳು ಇಲ್ಲಿವೆ. ಇದನ್ನು 'ಭಾರತದ ಸಿಲಿಕಾನ್ ವ್ಯಾಲಿ' ಮತ್ತು 'ಭಾರತದ ಉದ್ಯಾನ ನಗರ' ಎಂದೂ ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
passage_en: Bengaluru is the capital of Karnataka and a major IT hub of India. It hosts the headquarters of Infosys, Wipro, and hundreds of multinational tech companies. It is called the 'Silicon Valley of India' and also the 'Garden City of India'.

query_en: Where is the Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple) located?
answers: ਹਰਿਮੰਦਰ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਦੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਸਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਥਿਤ ਹੈ।
passage: ਹਰਿਮੰਦਰ ਸਾਹਿਬ, ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਦਰਬਾਰ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜਾਂ ਗੋਲਡਨ ਟੈਂਪਲ ਵੀ ਕਿਹਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਪੰਜਾਬ ਦੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਸਰ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਥਿਤ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਸਿੱਖ ਧਰਮ ਦਾ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰਾ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਦੀ ਉਸਾਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਨ ਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਨੇ 1604 ਵਿੱਚ ਕਰਵਾਈ ਸੀ।
passage_en: Harmandir Sahib, also known as Sri Darbar Sahib or the Golden Temple, is located in Amritsar, Punjab. It is the holiest Gurdwara in Sikhism. It was built by Guru Arjan Dev Ji in 1604.

query_en: Where is the Konark Sun Temple located?
answers: କୋଣାର୍କ ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟ ମନ୍ଦିର ଓଡ଼ିଶାର କୋଣାର୍କରେ ଅବସ୍ଥିତ।
passage: କୋଣାର୍କ ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟ ମନ୍ଦିର ଭାରତର ଓଡ଼ିଶା ରାଜ୍ୟର ପୁରୀ ଜିଲ୍ଲାର କୋଣାର୍କରେ ଅବସ୍ଥିତ। ଏହା ୧୩ ଶତାବ୍ଦୀରେ ରାଜା ନରସିଂହ ଦେବ ପ୍ରଥମ ଦ୍ୱାରା ନିର୍ମିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା। ଏହା ଏକ ୟୁନେସ୍କୋ ବିଶ୍ୱ ଐତିହ୍ୟ ସ୍ଥଳ ଏବଂ ଏହାର ରଥ ଆକୃତିର ସ୍ଥାପତ୍ୟ ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରସିଦ୍ଧ।
passage_en: The Konark Sun Temple is located in Konark, Puri district, Odisha, India. It was built in the 13th century by King Narasimha Deva I. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and is famous for its chariot-shaped architecture.

query_en: Where is the Kamakhya Temple located?
answers: কামাখ্যা মন্দিৰ গুৱাহাটীৰ নীলাচল পাহাৰত অৱস্থিত।
passage: কামাখ্যা মন্দিৰ অসমৰ গুৱাহাটী চহৰৰ নীলাচল পাহাৰত অৱস্থিত। ই ভাৰতৰ ৫১টা শক্তিপীঠৰ ভিতৰত অন্যতম আৰু হিন্দু ধৰ্মৰ এক গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ তীৰ্থস্থান। প্ৰতি বছৰে আহাৰ মাহত ইয়াত অম্বুবাচী মেলা অনুষ্ঠিত হয়।
passage_en: Kamakhya Temple is located on Nilachal Hill in Guwahati, Assam. It is one of the 51 Shakti Peethas of India and an important Hindu pilgrimage site. The annual Ambubachi Mela is held here every June.

query_en: Where is the Taj Mahal located?
answers: تاج محل آگرہ، اتر پردیش میں واقع ہے۔
passage: تاج محل بھارت کے شہر آگرہ، اتر پردیش میں دریائے جمنا کے کنارے واقع ہے۔ اسے مغل شہنشاہ شاہ جہاں نے اپنی بیوی ممتاز محل کی یاد میں 1632 میں تعمیر کرایا تھا۔ یہ سنگ مرمر سے بنا ہوا ہے اور دنیا کے سات عجائبات میں شامل ہے۔ یونیسکو نے اسے عالمی ثقافتی ورثے کا درجہ دیا ہے۔
passage_en: The Taj Mahal is located on the banks of the Yamuna river in Agra, Uttar Pradesh, India. It was built by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan in 1632 in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal. Made of white marble, it is one of the Seven Wonders of the World and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
